# `csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_declarations`

Maximum consecutive blank lines between members.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `1`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_declarations = <value>
```
